workflow: .agents/skills/skill-model: PokeAPI official artwork → openrouter/google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1 2×2 sheet → split-sheet.py → multiview-to-model
budgetNote: Part of the 3000-credit zone-content grant (docs/ZONE-CONTENT.md §2, models 47–55). Account balance is shared with concurrent batches, so per-batch balance before/after is not recorded; credits come from each task record. Eight of the nine submissions were first refused with HTTP 429 (concurrency limit) before any task was created and cost nothing; they were retried.
shippingPipeline: assets/prepare-game-models.py (Blender 5.2.3); swarm ~900 triangles (lickitung, poliwrath, electabuzz 1300), 512px base colour; guardians gyarados and starmie undecimated, 1024px; no rigging or paid conversion
facingVerification: Raw and shipping GLBs rendered from the run camera and four sides with render-compare.py, plus a lineup at proposed sim heights next to rattata, golem and scyther; all nine face glTF +X like rattata, so they take the default yaw (-π/2) and need no facingYaw entry.
rights: Unofficial, free non-commercial Pokémon fan project. Pokémon characters and names belong to their respective rights holders. AI generation does not transfer those character rights.

assets.name: 大舌头
assets.note: Decimated to 1300, not 900: at 900 the belly bands and feet tore UV seams into white flecks. Tongue drawn short and rolled onto the chest; proposed height 1.3, radius 0.65 (heavy leap tank).

assets.name: 金鱼王
assets.note: Second sheet (views/ built from sheet2.jpg): the first sheet was redrawn for cleaner side profiles before any Tripo spend. Thin opaque white fins; proposed height 1.0, radius 0.55, swims (water layer).

assets.name: 蚊香泳士
assets.note: Decimated to 1300, not 900: at 900 the back and legs tore UV seams into white flecks. Fists make it wide (1.44× height); proposed height 1.25, radius 0.6.

assets.name: 暴鲤龙
assets.note: Guardian (coast zone 2): static, undecimated, 1024px texture, like scyther. Drawn rearing from one tight coil so the long body fits a round footprint (0.92 × 0.80 of its height): at the proposed height 3.4 the footprint is ~3.1 × 2.7, radius 1.4. From the run camera it reads as head + coil; amphibious, walks on land.
